newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Polaroid an outperformer.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Polaroid an outperformer.

text.p: -- Lehman Bros analyst Ted Kundtz said in a research note he initiated coverage of Polaroid Corp with an outperform rating and a one-year price target of $50-$52 per share.
-- Shares rose 1/4 to 41-3/4 in early New York Stock Exchange trade.

-- "Polaroid shares, currently trading at 13.8 times and 11.4 ties our respective 1997 and 1998 (earnings) estimates, offer good value, in our view. Strong cash flow could be deployed for share buybacks, as well as acquisitions. Expect multiple expansion as top-line growth increases and operating margins expand. New manangement is heavily incentivized to see the stock move higher," the analyst stated.
